defined_text = {
    name = bca_gs_economic_difference_alloys_display
    random = no
    text = {
        trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_alloys_forbidden
                has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_alloys_unlimited
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_INACTIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_alloys
                value > 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_POSITIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_alloys
                value < 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_NEGATIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management } }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_ZERO
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { bca_country_needs_alloys = yes }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_NEEDS
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { bca_country_surplus_alloys = yes }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_SURPLUS
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_alloys
                value > 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_POSITIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_alloys
                value < 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_NEGATIVE
    }
    default = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_ALLOYS_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_ZERO

defined_text = {
    name = bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases_unit
    random = no
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_display_abs_value|SCRIPT_VALUE|bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases|
                value >= 1000000
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_DISPLAY_UNIT_M
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_display_abs_value|SCRIPT_VALUE|bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases|
                value >= 1000
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_DISPLAY_UNIT_K
    }
    default = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_DISPLAY_UNIT_EMPTY
}

    name = bca_gs_economic_income_exotic_gases_display

            }

                value < 0
            }
        }

defined_text = {
    name = bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases_display
    random = no
    text = {
        trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_exotic_gases_forbidden
                has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_exotic_gases_unlimited
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_INACTIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases
                value > 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_POSITIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases
                value < 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_NEGATIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management } }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_NEUTRAL_ZERO
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { bca_country_needs_exotic_gases = yes }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_NEEDS
    }
    text = {
        trigger = { bca_country_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_SURPLUS
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases
                value > 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_POSITIVE
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = value:bca_gs_economic_difference_exotic_gases
                value < 0
            }
        }
        localization_key = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_NEGATIVE
    }
    default = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_EXOTIC_GASES_DIFFERENCE_SATISFIED_ZERO
}
